description: This file defines the interface for the ec_ctrl_configurator_t class, which extends ec_configurator_t to implement control and handling logic for DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) in a Wi-Fi mesh configuration context. It includes method declarations for processing DPP messages, handling chirp notifications, onboarding, and creating DPP configuration frames, along with relevant data structures and private member variables.

classes.name: ec_ctrl_configurator_t
classes.description: A class extending ec_configurator_t that manages DPP-related control tasks, message processing, and frame generation for Wi-Fi mesh provisioning.

methods.name: process_chirp_notification
methods.description: Handles a chirp notification message TLV and directs it to the 1905 agent.

methods.name: onboard_enrollee
methods.description: Starts the onboarding process for an enrollee using provided bootstrapping data.

methods.name: process_proxy_encap_dpp_msg
methods.description: Processes a proxied encapsulated DPP message and directs it appropriately.

methods.name: process_direct_encap_dpp_msg
methods.description: Handles a direct encapsulated DPP message frame from the DPP protocol.

methods.name: handle_autoconf_chirp
methods.description: Handles a chirp found in an Autoconf Search message.

methods.name: handle_auth_response
methods.description: Handles an authentication response 802.11 frame involved in DPP.

methods.name: handle_proxied_dpp_configuration_request
methods.description: Processes a proxied DPP configuration request frame from an enrollee.

methods.name: handle_proxied_config_result_frame
methods.description: Handles a proxied DPP configuration result frame.

methods.name: handle_proxied_conn_status_result_frame
methods.description: Handles a proxied DPP connection status result frame.

methods.name: handle_recfg_announcement
methods.description: Handles a Reconfiguration Announcement frame.

methods.name: handle_recfg_auth_response
methods.description: Handles a Reconfiguration Authentication Response frame.

methods.name: finalize_dpp_config_obj
methods.description: Static method to finalize a DPP configuration JSON object with mandatory fields.

methods.name: create_auth_request
methods.description: Creates an authentication request for a given enrollee MAC address.

methods.name: create_recfg_auth_request
methods.description: Creates a reconfiguration authentication request.

methods.name: create_auth_confirm
methods.description: Creates an authentication confirmation message based on enrollee MAC, DPP status, and initial auth tag.

methods.name: create_recfg_auth_confirm
methods.description: Creates a reconfiguration authentication confirmation message.

methods.name: create_config_response_frame
methods.description: Generates a DPP configuration response frame encapsulated as an Encap DPP TLV.

methods.name: process_direct_encap_dpp_gas_msg
methods.description: Processes a GAS frame embedded in a direct encapsulated DPP message.

methods.name: find_conn_ctx
methods.description: Finds a connection context based on enrollee’s bootstrapping key hash instead of MAC address.

methods.name: handle_recfg_announcement
methods.description: Handles a Reconfiguration Announcement frame.

methods.name: handle_recfg_auth_response
methods.description: Handles a Reconfiguration Authentication Response frame.
